raw.title: Data Platform Engineer (f/m/d)  for the European AI Factory HammerHAI
raw.description:
Description:

Looking for an employer you can count on? Join us!

 

Data Platform Engineer (f/m/d) for the European AI Factory HammerHAI


Your Role and Responsibilities:

  • Developing and maintaining the data facility of the AI Factory including its software environments in the context of AI, HPC and data analytics use cases for modern AI, high-performance and cloud computing systems
  • Contributing to the initial (and evolving) service portfolio of the AI Factory within a friendly and open work environment in a highly motivated, international team with opportunities to contribute with your own ideas
  • Supporting and enabling customers to publish, access and share their own AI data sets and models
  • Fostering contact with collaboration partners as well as stakeholders from the European AI ecosystem, relying on your friendly personality and communication skills
  • Opportunities to work with national and European partners on novel AI R&D projects from the private and academic sectors
  • Maintaining relationships with technology providers and system developers (software/hardware)


Your Qualifications:

Required/Minimum Qualifications

 

  • PhD or Master’s degree in computer or data science, or other areas of scientific computing, or a Bachelor’s degree with multiple years (>3) of applied data platform development / engineering / deployment experience and/or working with AI data management workflows ideally as senior engineer in research or enterprise environments 

 

Other Requirements

  • Proficiency working in data center environments (incl. Linux, Git, Gitlab)
  • Willingness to keep up with current developments and to learn new technologies in the field of AI
  • Extensive knowledge and experience in developing and working with data platforms including their backend components in the context of AI, HPC and data analytics use cases (preferably piveau, www.piveau.de)
  • Extensive knowledge about and practical skills in specifying and implementing FAIR-aligned (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) data management workflows
  • Knowledge and experience in developing integration layers for connecting data infrastructure with external data platforms, preferably through metadata standards
  • Knowledge about and practical skills in secure and compliant data management, including AI models as well as data privacy standards and legislation
  • Excellent English and preferably German presentation and writing skills
 

Additional and Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge and experience with dataspaces, ideally within the Common European Data Space initiative
  • Knowledge and experience in software deployment and software lifecycle management (ideally based on principles of continuous integration/continuous deployment, CI/CD)
  • Basic knowledge and practical skills in software design and engineering
  • Basic knowledge and practical skills in IT and cybersecurity for software and software platform development
  • Experience with agile development methods


Conditions:

Working time

full time (40 hrs) / part-time possible

flexible working model with electronic time recording

Contract duration

End of Q1/2028, further employment is intended

Remuneration

up to E 13, see Entgelttabelle TV-L

Annual leave /                   compensatory time off

30 days 

(24.12. + 31.12. additionally day off)

Overtime is compensated by additional time off

Benefits

Up to 60% mobile work for suitable tasks, mostly two-person offices, bus and subway (U6) on the doorstep, free parking, pension plan of the Versorgungsanstalt des Bundes und der Länder (VBL), state-of-the-art work equipment, Cooperation Agreement with Sports Facility Providers for Discounted Membership


What you can expect at LRZ:

Are you looking for a multifaceted and intellectually stimulating position in a dynamic, cooperative and innovative work environment? Then LRZ is the place to be for you! Here at LRZ a collegial, appreciative work environment meets an international crowd of experts who work together to advance IT services for ground-breaking research. We offer flexible work schemes for an optimal work-life balance. Our staff values their creative leeway. As an institute of the Bavarian Academy of Science and Humanities we offer all the benefits of public service. And of course, no wishes remain unfulfilled at the LRZ in terms of technical equipment. We share experiences, constantly review and improve our processes, and are proud that our service-quality and data-security are regularly certified and rated highly. We actively promote diversity and welcome applications from talented individuals, regardless of cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, gender and sexual identity, physical abilities, religion and age. We give priority to applications from people with disabilities who are equally qualified (SGB IX).

title: Senior Rollout Manager (f/m/x) – DACH
description: Your mission IONITY baut ein europaweites Netzwerk von High-Power-Ladestationen auf und betreibt dieses. Als Senior Rollout Manager übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung mehrerer Ladestandorte in der DACH-Region – von der Rollout-Planung und der Standortvorbereitung über die Bauphase, Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme bis zur Übergabe an Operations. Du überführst komplexe, funktionsübergreifende Projekte in einen planbaren und verlässlichen Rollout neuer Standorte. Die Rolle verbindet Projektmanagement, Infrastrukturentwicklung und Stakeholder-Management. Du koordinierst interne Teams, Behörden, Grundstückseigentümer, Netzbetreiber, Baufirmen, Installationspartner und spezialisierte Partner auf gemeinsame Meilensteine, Entscheidungen und Qualitätsstandards. Deine Arbeit leistet einen direkten Beitrag zum Wachstum des europäischen IONITY Netzwerks, sowie einem zuverlässigen Ladeerlebnis für Elektrofahrzeugfahrerinnen und -fahrer aus ganz Europa. Jede neue Ladesäule als Ergebnis deiner Arbeit beschleunigt die Verkehrswende und ist ein wichtiger Beitrag für eine emissionsfreie Mobilität. Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für die Umsetzung eines Portfolios von HPC-Ladestandorten in der DACH-Region, mit besonderem Fokus auf die komplexesten, risikoreichsten oder strategisch wichtigsten Standorte. Über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg steuerst du Umfang, Zeitplan, Abhängigkeiten, Risikoexponierung, Kostenrisiken, Qualität, Sicherheit, Compliance und die betriebliche Umsetzungsreife. Du übersetzt die Rollout-Ziele in integrierte Standort- und Portfolioumsetzungspläne, definierst Prioritäten, Reihenfolgen, Meilensteine und Abhängigkeiten und stellst eine klare Governance sicher – von der Standortentwicklung und Genehmigungsplanung über die Bauphase und Inbetriebnahme bis zur Übergabe an den Betrieb. Du führst die funktionsübergreifende Umsetzung über die Bereiche Planung und Genehmigung, Bau, Netzanschluss, Logistik etc. hinweg, treibst zeitnahe Entscheidungen voran, löst Konflikte und stellst sicher, dass kritische Schnittstellen zwischen Grundstück, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Installation der Ladehardware, Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme aktiv gesteuert werden. Du steuerst externe Planungsbüros, Auftragnehmer, Installationsunternehmen und weitere Umsetzungspartner direkt, setzt klare Erwartungen, überwachst die Leistung, steuerst die operative Umsetzung sowie kommerzielle Risiken und stellst sicher, dass die Partner die vereinbarten Ergebnisse liefern. Strategisches Closing & C-Level Selling: Du navigierst komplexe Buying Center (CPO, CFO, IT-Leitung), baust Belieber- & Champion-Netzwerke auf Executive-Ebene auf und führst kommerzielle Verhandlungen (Preisgestaltung, Lizenzerweiterungen, Vertragsverlängerungen) eigenständig zum Abschluss. Executive Relationship & Account Planning: Du erstellst strategische Account-Pläne für deine Top-Kunden, führst regelmäßige Business Reviews (QBRs) auf C-Level durch und positionierst Mercanis als unverzichtbaren Software-Partner. Vorhersagbarkeit & Deal Execution: Du steuerst deine Deals anhand etablierter B2B-Sales-Methodiken (z. B. MEDDPICC), pflegst deine Pipeline im CRM mit hoher Forecasting-Genauigkeit und arbeitest eng mit dem Customer Success Team zusammen. Dein Profil B2B SaaS Closing-Erfahrung: Du bringst nachweisbare Erfolge im B2B-SaaS-Vertrieb (als Account Executive, Enterprise AM oder Senior Closing Role) mit – idealerweise im Umfeld von Procurement-, SCM- oder komplexen B2B-Enterprise-Lösungen. Track Record in Deal Execution: Du hast eine nachweisliche Historie im Erreichen oder Übertreffen deiner Umsatzziele (Quota) und bist vertraut mit komplexen Verkaufszyklen und mehrstufigen Decision-Making-Prozessen. Sales Methodik & Value Selling: Du beherrschst Value-Based Selling, kannst ROI-Analysen auf C-Level überzeugend präsentieren und bist geübt im Umgang mit Sales-Frameworks (z. B. MEDDPICC, SPIN, Challenger). Verhandlungssicherheit & C-Level-Flüssigkeit: Du verhandelst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch (muttersprachliches Niveau oder seit mindestens 10 Jahren im deutschen Geschäftsumfeld verankert) sowie verhandlungssicher auf Englisch. Präsenz & Skalierungs-Drive: Du wohnst in Berlin (oder bist umzugsbereit) für unser Office-First/Hybrid-Modell, arbeitest datengetrieben und bringst die Motivation mit, in einem schnell skalierenden Tech-Startup Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Compensation: Kompetitives Fixgehalt + attraktiver, ungedeckelter Bonus & VSOP (Beteiligungsmodell). Perks: Lebe das Scale-up-Life, regelmäßige Team Events & Offsites, und natürlich: kostenlose Uber-Eats-Meals & Uber-Rides, wenn’s mal wieder länger dauert. Room for Ideas: Wir leben eine offene Kultur mit echtem Sparring, du übernimmst Verantwortung und bekommst den Freiraum, deine Ideen voranzutreiben. Team Mindset: Werde Teil eines neugierigen, motivierten Teams, das mutig experimentiert, offen kommuniziert und sich stetig weiterentwickelt, gemeinsam und individuell. Dein Highlight im Job

In dieser Schlüsselrolle gestaltest du die finanzielle und strategische Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmens aktiv mit und übernimmst Verantwortung für zentrale Transformations- und Accounting-Projekte. Deine neue Rolle

  • Du verantwortest die Erstellung und Konsolidierung der Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse nach IFRS, HGB sowie weiteren relevanten Rechnungslegungsvorschriften und stellst ein termingerechtes Reporting sicher
  • Du leitest strategische Transformations- und Optimierungsprojekte, beispielsweise im Rahmen von Carve-outs, Prozessneustrukturierungen oder der Einführung neuer Geschäftsmodelle und Bilanzierungslogiken
  • Du entwickelst Accounting-, Reporting- und Kontrollprozesse kontinuierlich weiter und treibst die Qualität, Transparenz sowie Effizienz im Finanzbereich nachhaltig voran
  • Du fungierst als zentrale Schnittstelle zu Wirtschaftsprüfern, Aufsichtsbehörden, Investoren und internen Fachbereichen und steuerst externe Prüfungen sowie regulatorische Anforderungen
  • Du führst standortübergreifende Teams fachlich und disziplinarisch, förderst die Weiterentwicklung deiner Mitarbeitenden und schaffst ein motivierendes, leistungsorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld


Deine Stärken

  • Du verfügst über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs sowie über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Konzernrechnungswesen, in der Konsolidierung und im Financial Reporting eines komplexen Unternehmensumfelds

  • Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten und behältst auch bei komplexen bereichsübergreifenden Fragestellungen den Überblick 
  • Du vereinst starke Leadership-Kompetenzen mit einer hands-on Mentalität und schaffst es, Teams zu inspirieren, weiterzuentwickeln und gemeinsame Ziele erfolgreich zu erreichen; dabei kommunizierst du verhandlungssicher in deutscher und englischer Sprache

description: About Valiantys Valiantys helps organizations transform how work gets done across the enterprise, leading with transformation consulting, enterprise service management (ESM), and engineering productivity. By combining deep process expertise with modern collaboration, automation, and value stream practices, Valiantys enables business, IT, and product teams to design connected, efficient, and human-centered ways of working. You will report to the Managed Services Manager.  You will work with strategic enterprise clients, helping them get the most from their Atlassian Cloud environment. This is not a traditional reactive support role: we expect you to anticipate needs, identify improvement opportunities, challenge existing ways of working, and proactively bring new ideas and solutions to our clients. Alongside client-facing activities, you will help define the technical direction of the Managed Services team, explore emerging Atlassian Cloud capabilities, and turn new technologies and ideas into scalable services that can be deployed across our client portfolio. The role is preferably based in Germany and/or requires fluency in both German and English , as you will work closely with one of our enterprise clients, for whom German fluency is essential, as well as with our international teams. What You’ll Be Working On Deliver Technical Excellence Act as a senior technical expert for complex enterprise Atlassian Cloud environments. Proactively identify risks, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve platform stability, scalability, and adoption. Provide hands-on support on complex client needs while driving sustainable, long-term solutions. Shape & Scale Managed Services Help define the technical direction and standards of our Managed Services practice. Identify emerging or underused Atlassian Cloud capabilities and turn them into valuable, repeatable client services. Develop scalable offerings such as health checks, optimization services, and advanced analytics. Drive Innovation Explore how Atlassian Analytics, AI, and automation can improve client experience and Managed Services delivery. Collaborate with international teams to identify and scale successful practices and offerings across regions. Lead Through Expertise Act as a technical reference and mentor for the Managed Services team. Do You Have What It Takes? You bring 8–10+ years of experience in technical consulting, application support, platform operations, or similar enterprise technology environments. You have deep expertise in Atlassian Cloud and a strong understanding of the broader Atlassian ecosystem, its architecture, and best practices. You are comfortable tackling complex technical challenges and looking beyond immediate fixes to design scalable and sustainable solutions . You can assess client environments, identify areas for improvement, and proactively recommend ways to strengthen performance, governance, adoption, and scalability. You are curious about emerging technologies and keep up with the latest developments across the Atlassian ecosystem, particularly Atlassian Analytics, AI, automation, and Cloud innovation . You are able to turn new capabilities and ideas into practical solutions that create value for clients. You combine strong ownership and autonomy with a consultative mindset. You can independently lead technical initiatives, understand and challenge client requirements, and engage confidently with both technical and business stakeholders in complex enterprise environments. As a Principal Consultant, you naturally share your expertise and influence technical direction , helping colleagues grow and raising standards across the team. Aufgaben Du bespielst TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn und YouTube täglich mit mindestens einem Beitrag pro Kanal – ab deinem ersten Arbeitstag. Du bringst unsere bestehenden Kanäle in Ordnung: Profile, Bios, Highlights, Playlists und Alt-Content. Du produzierst Video-Content end-to-end: Konzept, Aufnahme, Schnitt, Untertitel, Veröffentlichung. Du gewinnst Händler-Testimonials selbst: Du identifizierst zufriedene Kunden gemeinsam mit unserem Sales- und Fulfillment-Team, rufst sie an, führst die Aufnahme per Video-Call, schneidest das Material, veröffentlichst es auf YouTube und verteilst es als Shorts auf allen Kanälen. Du machst aus Bewertungen, Ergebnissen und Projekten wiederverwendbare Formate: Karussells, Quote-Cards, Shorts. Du baust und betreibst den AI Twin unseres CEOs Sven-Oliver Stietzel (Stimme, Bild, Sprachstil) und produzierst damit CEO-Content, ohne seine Zeit zu beanspruchen. Wo er persönlich gebraucht wird, bereitest du alles so vor (Skript, Setup, Fragen), dass er in wenigen Minuten liefert. Du stellst sicher, dass jede fachliche Aussage zu Shopify, Migration und KI-Sichtbarkeit korrekt ist – dafür holst du dir das Wissen direkt bei unseren Experten im Team. Du lieferst wöchentlich ein KPI-Reporting an die Geschäftsführung. Qualifikation Du hast Social-Media-Kanäle nachweislich selbst aufgebaut und auf Reichweite gebracht. Die Links dazu sind Teil deiner Bewerbung. Du beherrschst Videoschnitt sicher (CapCut, Premiere Pro oder DaVinci Resolve) inklusive Aufnahme, Untertitelung und plattformgerechtem Export. Du bist am Telefon souverän und hast keine Hemmungen, Kunden aktiv für ein Testimonial anzusprechen. Du verstehst E-Commerce und Shopify oder arbeitest dich innerhalb von zwei Wochen ein. Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau. Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und lieferst remote ohne Kontrolle täglich Output. Du setzt um, statt lange zu planen. Erste Ergebnisse gibt es bei dir in Tagen, nicht in Wochen. Benefits Zusammenarbeit zunächst auf Freelance-Basis im Vollzeit-Umfang, 100 % remote in der DACH-Zeitzone Fixes Monatshonorar plus monatlicher Erfolgsbonus, gemessen an transparenten KPIs: Posting-Quote, Testimonials, Reichweite, Anfragen Volle Verantwortung für vier Kanäle ohne Freigabeschleife über die Geschäftsführung Direkter Zugang zu unseren Shopify- und KI-Experten für deine Inhalte Echtes Material statt Stockfotos: reale Händler, reale Ergebnisse, reale Bewertungen Software-Lizenzen und Tools stellen wir Ein AI-first Team mit 26 Jahren E-Commerce-Erfahrung, das Umsetzung höher bewertet als Meetings Perspektive: Bei erfolgreicher Zusammenarbeit können wir über Festanstellung – auch über internationale Strukturen, da wir mit zwei Gesellschaften in Deutschland und Dubai international aufgestellt sind Wir verzichten auf ein Anschreiben. Bitte reiche stattdessen ein: Links zu drei Social-Media-Kanälen, die du selbst aufgebaut hast, jeweils mit Follower-Stand zu Beginn und heute. Oder als Leadgenerator mit Leads vorher und nachher. Ein selbst geschnittenes Video von maximal 60 Sekunden zum Thema: Warum sollte ein Händler mit 1 Mio € Jahresumsatz seinen Shop auf Shopify migrieren? Fachlich korrekt und für Social Media aufbereitet. Vollständige Bewerbungen erhalten eine Rückmeldung. Bereit, unsere Erfolge in Reichweite zu verwandeln? Dann bewirb dich jetzt – nicht mit Worten, sondern mit deinem Video. Zeig uns, dass du der Typ Mensch bist, der postet, statt zu planen. NETSHAKE. 26 Jahre E-Commerce. 1.600 Projekte. In person in Ramstein, Germany

 

Why This Role Exists

As a Partner Engagement Manager at Onebrief, you're the customer's trusted technical partner. You serve as the subject-matter expert, maintaining power-user-level fluency in the platform. You stay current on product updates, translating new releases into practical impact for the specific workflows your customer relies on. You act as the primary line of communication between the customer and Onebrief — as the product evolves, you deliver ongoing, role-specific training to ensure users adopt new capabilities rather than getting stuck on outdated workflows. You bridge the technical gap between engineering and the customer, explaining product behavior in terms their staff can actually act on.

 

What You’ll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Clearly communicate user needs to the product team. Maintain a high product proficiency, and excite the customer about each product improvement.

  • Understand, request, and effectively leverage Company resources to meet the goals of the Company.

  • Lead or support exercises.

  • Use your observations of our users to recommend product improvements.

  • Identify gaps between existing directorate workflows and effective Onebrief usage, then drive adoption through hands-on configuration, user coaching, and workflow optimization.

  • When responding to incidents (product is unavailable, broken, or not delighting the customer), coordinate with the customer and our product engineering team.

  • Align your team’s efforts to deliver the best customer experience, while coordinating with fellow Partner Engagement Managers to ensure planning and workflows remain synchronized across commands.

  • Enable expansion and upsell opportunities to Allies and Partners by instilling the Onebrief value proposition.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven experience in leading operational planning within a military context, preferably at multi-star headquarters.

  • Exposure to large staff planning, through classical training in Professional Military Education or through service experience

  • Familiarity and experience with major military planning exercises and the protocols for software deployment on classified networks.

  • Proven ability to expand business presence within a customer location with emphasis on software or technology solutions.

  • Experience in customer support, both face-to-face and remote, and capability to respond to incidents coordinating with customers and product engineering teams.

  • Strong technical skills to master our application, troubleshoot issues and liaise with customers on technical matters.

  • Proven ability to navigate large government organizations, solve bureaucratic challenges, and deliver successful outcomes.

  • You hold a current Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI and have the ability to access DOD facilities and installations.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • You’re technically adept. You don’t need to code, but you do need to be savvy. Can you become a power user of our product and talk engineering with the customer?

  • Customers trust you. You demonstrate strong interpersonal skills, develop rapport, align diverse perspectives, and communicate with clarity and influence.

  • You’re intense about our mission. It’s a core part of who you are

  • You’re proactive and adaptable. You see a problem and get to work. You’re comfortable working autonomously or in a cross-functional team, especially in a fast-paced or ambiguous setting

  • You communicate clearly, concisely, and candidly. Our Company relies on you to assess the situation within your account and effectively communicate your assessment and recommendations to inform strategic decisions.

 

Indicators of Success

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months.

A successful Partner Engagement Manager will:

  • Opinion and expertise are valued by the customer and company alike (rapport/trust)

  • Learns quick, identifies opportunities and drives progress within the account (Forward-leaning/ bias for action)

  • Open-minded and able to pivot when priorities shift (Adaptability/ Humility)

raw.description:
Responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth.

Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network.

At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.

As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business.

  • As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem.
  • You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities.
  • You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems.
  • You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability.
  • You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly.
  • You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption.
  • You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes.


Skills

  • Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus).
  • Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics.
  • Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation.
  • Business fluency in both English and German is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff. 


What we offer

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.

Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.

Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.

Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. Deployment, Projektmanagement, Einkauf, Legal) als auch externen Partnern. Du hast Erfahrungen und sehr gute Kenntnisse im Bereich FttH-Ausbau (passive und aktive Netzkomponenten). Du bist ein verantwortungsbewusster Teamplayer mit Start-up-Mindset: eigeninitiativ, serviceorientiert, selbstständig und neugierig für Neues in einem stark wachsenden Markt. description: Westbridge-Gruppe | Was uns antreibt Gebäude müssen heute mehr leisten als je zuvor: effizienter werden, Ressourcen schonen und gleichzeitig wirtschaftlich betrieben werden. Dafür braucht es Transparenz, messbare Daten und intelligente Lösungen. Als einer der führenden Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsberater für die Immobilienwirtschaft in Europa treiben wir diesen Wandel aktiv mit. Wir unterstützen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden dabei, Gebäude und Portfolios fit für die Zukunft zu machen – von der ersten strategischen Idee über die technische Planung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Um diesen Weg weiterzugehen und gemeinsam mit unseren Kundinnen und Kunden die Energieversorgung von morgen zu gestalten, suchen wir dich als Working Student im Projektmanagement (m/w/d) für unser Team Energy International in Frankfurt am Main . Deine Aufgaben In deiner Rolle übernimmst du Verantwortung und arbeitest gemeinsam mit deinem Team an Lösungen für anspruchsvolle Fragestellungen. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem: Du unterstützt das Projektmanagement International bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung innovativer Konzepte zur Kostenoptimierung sowie Effizienzsteigerung im Energieverbrauch. Im Rahmen deiner Tätigkeit wirkst Du bei der Analyse, Aufbereitung und Auswertung projektrelevanter Daten mit und leistest damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Entscheidungsfindung. Du unterstützt das Team im operativen Projektmanagement-Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst dabei organisatorische und koordinative Aufgaben. Zudem begleitest du Ausschreibungsprozesse sowie Bietergespräche und unterstützt bei der Kommunikation mit externen Partnern, insbesondere internationale Energieversorgern. Die Vorbereitung und Strukturierung von Vertragsunterlagen für Verhandlungen gehört ebenfalls zu deinem Aufgabenbereich. Darüber hinaus erstellst du Präsentationen zur Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und wirkst bei der Aufbereitung von Ergebnissen für interne und externe Stakeholder mit. Das bringst du mit Fachliche Kompetenz, Kommunikationsstärke und die Bereitschaft, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, sind für uns genauso wichtig wie deine Freude an Zusammenarbeit und daran, gemeinsam gute Lösungen zu entwickeln. Du befindest dich aktuell in einem Studium an einer Fach- oder Hochschule – vorzugsweise in den Bereichen Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Energiewirtschaft oder BWL. Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Projektmanagement oder in der Energie- bzw. Immobilienwirtschaft gesammelt. Du zeichnest dich durch lösungsorientiertes, analytisches und strukturiertes Denken und Handeln aus. Teamfähigkeit und Einsatzbereitschaft gehören ebenso zu deinen Stärken wie ein professionelles und sicheres Auftreten. Du verfügst über gute Grundkenntnisse in MS-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere in Excel. So arbeiten wir Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus unterschiedlichen Fachrichtungen zusammen und erhältst Einblicke in spannende Projekte und Themen rund um die Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsberatung. Dabei kannst du dein Wissen aus dem Studium einbringen, praktische Erfahrungen sammeln und dich fachlich weiterentwickeln. Damit dies gelingt, bieten wir dir die entsprechenden Rahmenbedingungen: Wir bieten dir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem du dich gut einfinden und konzentriert arbeiten kannst – mit moderner Ausstattung, guter Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr sowie Getränken, Snacks und frischem Obst. Bei Werkstudententätigkeiten richten wir uns nach deinem Studium: Während des Semesters kannst du uns bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen, in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit nach Absprache auch in Vollzeit. Praktika absolvierst du bei uns in Vollzeit. ecoplanet gives industrial companies the kind of energy management a corporate energy department would provide, without needing one of their own. Our platform covers meter data, consumption monitoring, efficiency analysis, compliance, and energy procurement. We're a Series A company backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital.


Why This Role Matters

You'll be the designer on our Energy Insights team. The team owns our core entry product: 24/7 consumption monitoring, alerting, and the insights that turn load profiles into decisions a customer can act on. Your work covers the whole customer journey, from onboarding and labelling a customer's meters, to surfacing findings they can trust, to making sure they come back regularly.

You'll be the only designer on this team, working directly with a PM, engineers, and our customer success team. Much of the work is improving and reshaping features we already have, so you'll be making existing things clearer and more useful as well as designing new ones.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Own design for the Energy Insights product end to end: research, flows, interaction design, and polished UI
  • Redesign existing features, such as the customer cockpit, monitoring views, alerts, and findings, so energy managers can go from "something's off" to "here's what to do" quickly
  • Design data-dense interfaces (load profiles, consumption breakdowns, anomalies) that stay readable for people who aren't data analysts
  • Shape onboarding and labelling flows that help customers describe their meters and production so our insights improve over time
  • Design internal tools for our customer success and onboarding teams. They're users too.
  • Talk to customers regularly and turn what you learn into design decisions
  • Help build and maintain a pragmatic design system that fits how we ship


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • B2B product design experience — you've designed complex software for professional users, not only consumer apps
  • A portfolio showing data-heavy, workflow-driven product work, and the reasoning behind it
  • Comfort working as a solo designer: you set your own process, make calls without waiting for sign-off, and know when "good enough to learn from" beats "perfect"
  • An early-stage mindset — priorities shift as we learn, and you treat ambiguity as something to work through, not around
  • Strong interaction and visual design skills; fluent in Figma
  • Willingness to talk to users directly and bring evidence into design discussions

As the sole designer on a core product team, you'll set the design practice for Energy Insights largely on your own terms — there's no senior designer above you dictating process. description: ↳ Alternative locations: Barcelona, Frankfurt a.M., Leipzig, Sevilla Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies – "Vicos". We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing. Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies. Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SME. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market. Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization. Given its ambitious and transformative purpose, our platform is highly complex (though easy use). Developing it further takes engineers who combine technical excellence, pragmatic judgement and entrepreneurial spirit. The Tech Lead: AI & Innovation we are looking for embodies these qualities in his or her leadership. He or she is up for making a major contribution to our company and to our society. Tasks As the most senior engineer, you'll lead, grow and enable a small team of (forward deployed) engineers: hire, onboard, coach and make every engineer successful in their role. Own the technical direction and technology decisions for Vicoland. Set the architecture across the stack, from frontend to infrastructure, and make sure what we build is scalable, robust and maintainable. Stay hands-on: contribute code yourself, build prototypes, and use AI to aggressively ship high-quality software alongside your team. Translate business needs into technical roadmaps in close cooperation with Business Development, Product and other stakeholders. Prioritize, scope and make trade-offs explicit. Own delivery end-to-end for your team: design, development, QA, deployment and production monitoring, with clear engineering standards and quality gates. Establish how we build with AI: best practices for context engineering, model selection, evaluation, tracing and observability, so that quality is measured, not assumed. Run architectural discussions, code reviews and retrospectives; create a culture of ownership, constructive challenge and continuous learning. Act as a sparring partner to the Chief Product Officer and the leadership team on technology strategy, build-vs-buy decisions and team setup. Requirements Have proven people leadership experience: you have led an engineering team (ideally 3+ engineers), including hiring, performance conversations, career development and coaching. Have excelled somewhere, somehow through an impactful technical contribution, one which we can talk about, and still enjoy writing code yourself. Have deep hands-on experience across the stack (frontend, backend, data, infrastructure/cloud) and a track record of architecting and shipping production-grade software, preferably with AI components (LLMs, embeddings, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents, PyTorch/TensorFlow). Have experience developing AI agents and integrating them into business workflows. Be on top of the latest tools, models and trends in AI-assisted software engineering. You are excellent at context engineering (incl. prompting), know when to leverage which model, and have first-hand experience with Claude Code or Cursor, and you know how to roll these practices out across a team. Know how to evaluate what gets built. You can design eval sets, work with LLM-as-judge or ground-truth data, use tracing and observability tooling to find and fix regressions, and make evaluation a team habit. Practice a truly agnostic approach to stack and tools: you pick the right tech for the problem, not vice versa, and can explain your choices to both engineers and business stakeholders. Balance autonomy and alignment: you drive your team from idea to finished product independently, while knowing when to involve, align with or escalate to others. Have the ability to thoughtfully challenge ideas and drive constructive discussions with engineers, product owners, the Chief Product Officer and business leadership. Lead with humility: you create psychological safety, give and receive honest feedback, and measure your success by the success of your team. Reside within ±3 hours of Central European Time (to enable effective collaboration), at best in one of our office locations in Barcelona, Berlin, Frankfurt, Leipzig, and Sevilla. Full professional proficiency in English at C2 level. Professional proficiency in German at C1 level. Bonus Experience building or scaling an engineering team in a startup or scale-up environment. Prior experience integrating AI into SaaS business workflows, ideally in a client-facing or forward-deployed setup. Familiarity with the modern AI-tooling ecosystem (agents, memory systems, vector databases, orchestration frameworks). Experience working with distributed or multi-location teams. Benefits You’ll work in an international, closely knit team of high‑performers and entrepreneurial spirits. Remote‑friendly + flexible work hours. Excellent compensation + participation in the company through our ESOP. Growth mindset: Hard skills are important — but mindset matters more. If you meet most of the requirements and you’re hungry to learn, apply anyway. If you’re a high‑impact tech lead who thrives on autonomy, drives real results, and is passionate about applying AI to change how teams work - let’s talk. Even if you don’t check every bullet above, but you bring exceptional drive, creativity, and a growth mindset, please apply. We believe the right mindset counts more than checkboxes. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.&nbsp;</div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports &amp; entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>Fanatics Collectibles is seeking an experienced Legal Director, International to join the Fanatics Collectibles legal team. This is full-time, 5 days on-site role based at Fanatics Collectibles’ UK headquarters in St. Pancras, London, also requiring frequent trips to our office in Milton Keynes.</p> <p>This role will be cross-functional and support all business groups across all areas of Fanatics Collectibles various businesses outside of the US. You will be a strategic hands-on, results-oriented, business-minded lawyer. You will provide advice on a diverse range of matters related to day-to-day business and operations to all level of team members.</p> <p>When determining pay, as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as experience and other qualifications.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Day-to-day responsibilities will include:</p> <ul> <li>Rendering advice and guidance regarding legal strategy, interpretation and all legal, compliance and regulatory matters;</li> <li>Drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a broad variety and frequent heavy load of commercial agreements, ranging from the day-to-day/routine to super complex transactions, as well as terms and conditions for merchandise purchases, offerings and products on any scale;</li> <li>Providing advice and counsel on marketing and promotions matters, including review of contest rules and digital content, including webpages and online promotions;</li> <li>Engaging, and supervising outside counsel with an eye on careful cost control;</li> <li>Developing and creating business level appropriate policies controls, procedures and programs;</li> <li>Conducting training related to all responsibility areas.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills, Competencies, and Capabilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>An action and initiative taker;</li> <li>A “doer” who is ready, willing, and able to roll up sleeves, jump in and <em><u>get things done</u>;</em></li> <li>A self-starter with a strong work ethic, capable of taking ownership of projects/matters through excellent completion;</li> <li>Have a strong desire to assume a wide variety of responsibilities, learn, stretch, and grow;</li> <li>Able to accomplish multiple tasks at once while balancing competing objectives and deadlines</li> <li>Produce high-quality carefully crafted work product in a timely manner;</li> <li>Have strong interpersonal skills and ability to forge strong relationships with key stakeholders</li> <li>Work effectively both independently and as a team player in a team oriented environment, friendly, and excited about “play nice” culture;</li> <li>Confident, collaborator and initiative taker, a leader from inception;</li> <li>Do not watch the clock, be flexible, invested, committed and immersed in the excitement about and commitment to the success of our businesses;</li> <li>Strong understanding of the Fanatics Collectibles businesses and overall Fanatics current and potential operations;</li> <li>A creative thinker who can initiate and develop alternative approaches to complex issues</li> <li>A “how” state of mind, not a yes/no advisor;</li> <li>Professional and have a non-negotiable sense of integrity, reliable and does the right thing;</li> <li>Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail;</li> <li>Excellent legal and business acumen and problem-solving skills;</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills (verbal and written) with the ability to synthesize complex data for a range of audiences. Ability to advise all levels of seniority, summarize the bottom line in a concise manner but also to expand to the full spectrum of details and analysis as appropriate;</li> <li>Able to function in excellence in a high-paced, entrepreneurial and constantly evolving and fast-moving environment;</li> <li>Aim and work to be best in class – impactful goal oriented and task focused learner who is innovative and influential;</li> <li>Ambassador of the Fanatics brand who brings passion, energy and positivity into the workplace</li> <li>Ability to travel frequently on short notice.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Current Practicing Certificate (UK) or equivalent;</li> <li>Bachelor of Law (LLB) / Masters of Law (LLM) / CPE and Legal Practice Course (LPC);</li> <li>8+ years PQE; prior significant in-house experience and/or BigLaw international firm; inhouse experience for a multinational company with US headquarters preferred;</li> <li>Multi-jurisdictional legal coverage experience preferred;</li> <li>Effective verbal and written communication skills with confidence to communicate with business leaders and all level of employees;</li> <li>Practical and proactive problem solver with a positive attitude;</li> <li>Proficiency in the use and application of AI in a legal environment.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>The above list of job duties is not exclusive or exhaustive and the post holder will be required to undertake such tasks as may reasonably be expected within the scope and grading of the post.</em><br><br><em>Subject to applicable laws, Fanatics Collectibles may choose to run a background check.</em></p> <p><em>Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don’t fall victim to fraud.&nbsp; Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants.&nbsp;Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including ----- For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at&nbsp;<a href="http://www.fanaticsinc.com/careers">www.fanaticsinc.com/careers</a></em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our&nbsp;<a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Revenue Enablement Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>You'd own the design and delivery of Mews' first dedicated commercial enablement function inside Onboarding: turning onboarding professionals across a global, distributed team into consultants who can spot and act on expansion revenue, without inheriting anyone else's playbook.</p> <p>Most onboarding organisations treat go-live as the finish line, so the upsell and cross-sell signals sitting inside existing project portfolios go unqualified and never reach Sales. At Mews, that gap sits inside a fast-growing hospitality tech customer base, where every project portfolio onboarding already manages is effectively an unworked pipeline of expansion revenue.</p> <p>You'll work closely with Onboarding leadership globally, plus Sales, Customer Success and RevOps, to define what a qualified expansion lead looks like and get it moving to the right team. This is a new role, not a backfill, so the coaching model, playbooks and success metrics are yours to build from scratch.</p> <p>This role exists because Onboarding's project portfolios are growing faster than the team's ability to work them commercially, and right now, nobody owns that motion end to end.</p> <h4><strong>What you would do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Design and deliver consultative sales training for onboarding professionals, covering discovery, opportunity qualification, objection handling and commercial conversations that keep the customer's trust intact</li> <li>Build an ongoing coaching programme that grows consultative skill progressively, from new joiners through tenured consultants, and onboard new starters into the commercial side of the role from day one</li> <li>Develop playbooks and frameworks, including AI-assisted tools, that help the team surface and qualify upsell and cross-sell signals across their project portfolios at scale</li> <li>Partner with Sales, Customer Success and RevOps to define a qualified expansion lead and build the handoff process between Onboarding and Sales</li> <li>Track commercial performance across the portfolio (pipeline generated, expansion revenue influenced, handoff quality) and use it to keep improving the programme</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Fluency Level 3:</strong> in this role, that means redesigning how the wider onboarding team spots and qualifies commercial signals, not just using AI to work faster yourself. You'll build AI-assisted frameworks and tools that other onboarding professionals can use on their own portfolios, and you'll actively check what those tools flag before it shapes a playbook or gets treated as a qualified lead.</p> <p><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to <a href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/x/XQOskg">"AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates"</a>.</em></p> <h4><strong>What you would bring</strong>&nbsp;</h4> <ul> <li>4+ years in Revenue Enablement, Sales Enablement or Commercial Training, with direct exposure to consultative or solution-selling methodologies</li> <li>A background as a quota-carrying sales rep, account manager or customer success leader: you've had the commercial conversations you'll be teaching others to have</li> <li>Deep familiarity with consultative sales frameworks (MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN or equivalent), and comfort adapting them to a post-sale, trust-based context</li> <li>A coaching instinct: you can watch a customer interaction, spot the missed commercial moment, and give feedback specific enough to change what happens next time</li> <li>AI Fluency Level 3 or equivalent hands-on experience: comfortable redesigning workflows with AI, building tools colleagues can reuse, and checking AI output rather than taking it at face value</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Nice to have</strong>&nbsp;</h4> <ul> <li>A data-driven mindset: comfortable defining success metrics and iterating a programme based on results</li> <li>Experience designing and delivering training for customer-facing teams in a SaaS B2B environment</li> <li>Strong facilitation and presentation skills, and comfort operating across a large, distributed global team where influence often has to happen without formal authority</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Spain</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€47.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€65.500 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">UK</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£53,500</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£68,800 GBP</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Ireland</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€61.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€82.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>Pay Transparency at Mews</strong></h4> <p>Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.</p> <p>This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.</p> <p>If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></h4> <p>Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.</p> <h4><strong>Global benefits</strong></h4> <p>No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)</li> <li>Participation in our company share program</li> <li>Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)</li> <li>An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development</li> <li>Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself</li> <li>A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year</li> <li>Relocation options, available after one year</li> <li>Flexible, hybrid working options</li> <li>A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance</li> <li>Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Local benefits</strong></h4> <p>You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.</p> <h4><strong>Life at Mews</strong></h4> <p>We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.</p> <p>We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.</p> <p>A few things that define how we work:</p> <ul> <li>High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.</li> <li>Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.</li> <li>We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.</li> <li>AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.</li> </ul> <p>If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.</p> <p>We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.</p> <p>One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.</p> <p>If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">This role owns paid search at Mews end to end, across every market we operate in. Paid search is one of our core acquisition channels, so the strategy, the budget decisions, and the performance against target all sit with one person rather than being split across an agency and a manager above them. The environment is genuinely complex: multiple markets, multiple languages, and a commercial motion running from small independent properties through to enterprise hotel groups.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">You will set the direction and define what good looks like across those markets, then back every move with data. Day to day you will work closely with Data, Measurement, Finance, Brand, and Regional Marketing, which means search activity gets tied to real commercial priorities rather than optimised in isolation. Hospitality tech is a fast-moving category with unusual search behaviour across regions, and the person in this seat has the room to shape how Mews shows up in it.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>What you would do</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Own paid search strategy across all Mews markets: planning, execution, optimisation, testing, and reporting.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Hold performance against acquisition, revenue, ROI, and efficiency targets, and make the budget calls that follow.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Work with Product Marketing, Brand, Data, Finance, and Regional Marketing to align search activity with commercial priorities.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Build AI-assisted workflows into how search gets run here: query and creative analysis, ad copy generation and testing at scale, anomaly detection across markets, and documenting those workflows so the wider marketing team can use them.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Manage agency and platform relationships, and find growth through experimentation, automation, and new platform capabilities.</li> </ul> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>AI Fluency Level 3:</strong> in this role that means you have already changed how paid search work gets done, not just sped up your own tasks. You have built something repeatable, whether that is an AI-assisted process for keyword and query mining, creative iteration, or performance anomaly review, and handed it to others in a form they can actually run. It also means you check what the model gives you. When AI proposes a bid change, a negative keyword list, or a read on why CAC moved, you know how to test that claim against the data before it reaches a live budget.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to <a class="underline underline underline-offset-2 decoration-1 decoration-current/40 hover:decoration-current focus:decoration-current" href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/x/XQOskg">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a> on Confluence.</em></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>What you would bring</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Deep working knowledge of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads: bidding strategies, attribution, conversion tracking, and web measurement are things you know well, not things you are still learning.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">A clear record of improving paid search performance against measurable targets such as acquisition volume, CAC, or ROI.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Comfort with large datasets and the quantitative judgement to turn them into sound commercial decisions.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Experience with reporting and visualisation tools such as GA4, Looker, Tableau, or SQL, plus a solid grasp of measurement and experimentation methodology.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">AI Fluency Level 3, or the equivalent hands-on experience applying AI to paid search or performance marketing work.</li> </ul> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>Nice to have</strong> </p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 pl-2">Multi-market or multi-language campaign experience.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Exposure to a commercial motion spanning SMB through enterprise.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Spain</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€51.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$170,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>Pay Transparency at Mews</strong></h4> <p>Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.</p> <p>This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.</p> <p>If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></h4> <p>Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.</p> <h4><strong>Global benefits</strong></h4> <p>No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)</li> <li>Participation in our company share program</li> <li>Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)</li> <li>An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development</li> <li>Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself</li> <li>A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year</li> <li>Relocation options, available after one year</li> <li>Flexible, hybrid working options</li> <li>A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance</li> <li>Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Local benefits</strong></h4> <p>You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.</p> <h4><strong>Life at Mews</strong></h4> <p>We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.</p> <p>We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.</p> <p>A few things that define how we work:</p> <ul> <li>High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.</li> <li>Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.</li> <li>We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.</li> <li>AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.</li> </ul> <p>If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.</p> <p>We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.</p> <p>One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.</p> <p>If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the<a href="https://www.wiz.io/blog/100m-arr-in-18-months-wiz-becomes-the-fastest-growing-software-company-ever"> fastest-growing startups ever,</a> we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven<a href="https://www.g2.com/products/wiz-wiz/reviews"> track record of success</a> and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now<a href="https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/identity-security/google-completes-acquisition-of-wiz"> powered by Google</a>, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.</p> <p>Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!</p></div><h3><strong>Role Description</strong></h3> <p>At Wiz, we're passionate about technical sales and helping our partners and their customers achieve maximum value. This starts with a team effort, collaborating with all available Wiz resources and teaming with the best partners in the world.&nbsp; Cloud transformation isn't slowing down, and with the explosion of autonomous AI agents, frontier models, and multi-tenant cloud architectures, the demand for next-generation MSP and MDR services is shifting overnight. We don't react to trends, we set the standard.&nbsp; As a <strong>Partner Solutions Architect (MSP)</strong>, you won't just be supporting sales deals; you will influence and execute our technical MSP strategy from the ground up. Sitting at the absolute bleeding edge of technology, you will serve as the lead technical strategist empowering top-tier Managed Service Providers to rethink cloud security, package high-margin Wiz-powered offerings, and protect their clients' multi-cloud estates with the power of the Wiz Security Graph and our agentless architecture.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Drive <strong>technical strategy and solution development</strong> with MSP Partners</li> <li>Build and deliver <strong>world-class demos and technical enablement</strong> experiences for our partners.</li> <li><strong>Architect an integrated solution and messaging</strong>, aligning with the MSP global team.</li> <li>Deeply engage with MSP Partner technical teams to build champions and identify opportunities to leverage technical integrations to drive deal acceleration.</li> <li>Serve as a <strong>technical evangelist and trusted advisor</strong> for cloud security, representing Wiz at partner and industry events.</li> <li>Assist partners in building a strong <strong>technical business delivery model</strong> around Wiz.</li> <li>Travel up to 40% of the time as needed.</li> </ul> <h3>Minimum qualifications</h3> <ul> <li><strong>5+ Years of Cloud security expertise:</strong> Strong fluency in CSPM, CIEM, IaC security, containers, and serverless architectures.</li> <li><strong>Deep hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, and/or Azure</strong>.</li> <li><strong>DevSecOps &amp; Supply Chain Security:</strong> Hands-on DevSecOps experience and deep familiarity with CI/CD processes, IaC tooling (Terraform, CloudFormation), and shifting security left.</li> <li><strong>Systems &amp; Identity Expertise:</strong> Solid foundation in operating systems, virtual machines, container orchestration, and cloud identity (IAM, access, certificates, keys).</li> <li><strong>Sales Engineering Excellence:</strong> Proven track record in a technical pre-sales role delivering complex solutions and strategic storytelling to C-level executives at technology partners.</li> <li><strong>Managed Services (MSP) DNA:</strong> Understanding of the MSP partner ecosystems. You know how MSPs build, price, and scale managed security offerings, manage SLAs, and drive technical adoption with internal engineering and SOC teams.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred qualifications</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Managed AI Security &amp; AI-SPM:</strong> Experience discovering shadow AI and securing cloud AI/ML workloads (AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, OpenAI, Anthropic) to help partners package and deliver managed AI security posture services to clients.</li> <li><strong>Agentic Workflows &amp; AI Guardrails:</strong> Familiarity with securing autonomous AI agents, agentic workflows, and emerging standards like Model Context Protocol (MCP) to define zero-trust access boundaries and runtime guardrails across client environments.</li> <li><strong>SOC Efficiency &amp; AI-Driven SecOps:</strong> Practical experience leveraging AI and automation to streamline multi-tenant SOC operations, accelerate incident triage, reduce alert fatigue, and automate remediation workflows.</li> <li><strong>MDR &amp; CNAPP Runtime Security:</strong> Experience with container security, eBPF, Kubernetes admission controllers, and real-time threat detection to power high-efficacy Managed Detection &amp; Response (MDR) offerings.</li> <li><strong>Managed DSPM &amp; Regulatory Compliance:</strong> Experience implementing automated data discovery, lineage, and cloud data governance frameworks tailored to client compliance requirements (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, FedRAMP).</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><span class="TextRun SCXW149741735 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW149741735 BCX0">Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country where the position is based,&nbsp;</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW149741735 BCX0">without the need for</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW149741735 BCX0">visa </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW149741735 BCX0">sponsorship.</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW149741735 BCX0">This</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW149741735 BCX0"> role does not offer</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW149741735 BCX0">visa</span></span> <span class="TextRun SCXW149741735 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW149741735 BCX0">sponsorship</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW149741735 BCX0">.</span></span></em></p> <p>Wiz is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.&nbsp;</p> <p>By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wiz will process your personal data in accordance with <a href="https://www.wiz.io/legal/privacy" target="_blank">Wiz's Privacy Policy.</a></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
